name: Shanghai International Circuit

sources.geometry: OpenStreetMap circuit relation 2094941 / way 156328670 (© OSM contributors), start at its "start" node 1686043686, Taubin-smoothed, 3 m stations
sources.width: Published: 13-15 m (Tilke, https://tilke.de/portfolio/shanghai-international-circuit/), mapped per section (main straight/Turn 1 16 m, back straight 15 m, Turn 14 braking zone 17 m, rest 14 m)
sources.elevation: Copernicus GLO-30 DSM (https://copernicus-dem-30m.s3.amazonaws.com/, tile N31 E121), robust median ~250 m; site is flat reclaimed land
sources.pit: OpenStreetMap ways 107371147 + 107371138 (pit lane in circuit relation 2094941)
sources.trim: Medium downforce: long back straight vs Turn 1-2 snail and slow corners, close to the Spa reference
sources.pitLimit: FIA Chinese GP event notes: pit lane speed limit 80 km/h
sources.pitLoss: Typical F1 pit-stop loss ~22-23 s at Shanghai (F1/Pirelli strategy previews); approximate
sources.raceLaps: FIA 2026 Chinese GP: 56 laps; 2026 sprint weekend (sprint 19 laps)

notes: Turn numbering per FIA (16 turns); apexes placed at curvature peaks. Elevation from a 30 m surface model: only the broad trend (a few metres) is meaningful.
